entries.name: Mitr Street
entries.description: Six-storey Thai-Chinese street-food house from the Ruay Mitr team, with ThaiKi Rooftop Bar overlooking Wat Pho.

entries.name: Kizaru
entries.description: Late-night Tokyo-style izakaya at Montien Mall from Chef Shun Sato, with regional and unpasteurised sake.

entries.name: FRICKIN' Fried Chicken
entries.description: Nashville hot chicken spin-off of Birdies, now open at PRIME Thonglor with cocktails and comfort sides.

entries.name: Jaan Ranjuan
entries.description: New cocktail and tea lounge debuting alongside Michelin-starred Saneh Jaan, built on Thai herbs and flowers.

entries.name: Le Manoir Botanica - Le Bistro
entries.description: French bistro classics with Northern Thai highland ingredients in a century-old Lanna manor, under Chef Olivier Elzer (soft-opened July; covered this week).

entries.name: Le Manoir Botanica Dining Room
entries.description: 18-seat French haute-cuisine counter announced for the coming months.

entries.name: FRICKIN' Phuket
entries.description: Second FRICKIN' branch confirmed for One MontAzure.

entries.name: Bo.bkk Wine Bar
entries.description: Run-club cafe Bo.bkk adding a second-floor wine bar.

trend_note: Openings lean on heritage-shophouse conversions in the Old Town and Japanese late-night formats; most are brand extensions (rebrands, second floors, sibling lounges) rather than wholly new concepts.
